sloka: तत् श्रुत्वा विषसाद एव द्वितीया प्रिय शम्सनात् ।विषण्ण वदनो भूत्वा भूयः पप्रच्च मातरम् ॥२-७२-३९॥
transliteration: tat śrutvā viṣasāda eva dvitīyā priya śamsanāt ।viṣaṇṇa vadano bhūtvā bhūyaḥ papracca mātaram ॥2-72-39॥

translations.english: Bharata was more distraught on hearing the words that conveyed the second unpleasant tidings. With downcast countenance, he again enquired of his mother thus:
